files.name: SwimOut.java

help: swim_out: after shore failed, swim by hand on the surface (forward+jump) to seen land, re-targeting on stalls
lesson: Repeated shore TIMEOUTs come from a 90 s pathed swim that doesn't move the bot. After one failure, swimming by hand on the surface toward seen land (or straight ahead), and switching targets when it stalls, should beat trying the same route again.
summary: swim_out steers by hand, holding forward and jump, toward the nearest dry land the bot has seen. It is offered after shore times out or gets stuck, so the bot stops repeating 90 s shore timeouts in open water.
